build_coco_dataset: build a COCO detection dataset for train or val splits using the build function
create_coco_transforms: create COCO data augmentation transforms for training or validation image sets
convert_coco_polys_to_mask: convert COCO polygon segmentations into binary mask tensors for instance segmentation
filter_coco_categories: filter and remap COCO annotation category IDs to a subset of classes
review_cocodetection_class: review the CocoDetection class that extends torchvision CocoDetection with transforms and mask preparation
